coordinate_convention: All row and column identifiers are zero based. display_row and map_array_row directly index the original JSON mapData.map; source_row and engine_row = map_rows - 1 - display_row use the bottom-origin engine convention. Pixels have original-image top-left origin.
inspection: Both unmodified original PNGs were actually inspected through view_image, including original-detail views. Original level mapData was read to verify the requested tile identities.
method: Each original-image pixel coordinate was estimated directly from the independently visible ground face and its tile boundaries. No projection, fitted transform, interpolation, extrapolation, automatic center extraction, or other reader output was used. An unreadable or occluded ground face would retain its request row with observed_pixel=null.
limitations: These are approximate visible-ground-center readings from the original 512x286 images, not absolute in-game position verification. Reader agreement alone cannot establish absolute game accuracy.
frozen_rule: Do not modify these readings after the first write. Any later discussion must retain this frozen original.
